_doc: Benchmarks are always shortlisted. deny = discovered sites excluded by hand, shown greyed out with the stated reason. Keys are '<osm type>/<osm id>'.

benchmarks.name: St. Lorenzkirche plaza
benchmarks.note: OSM maps Lorenzer Platz only as pedestrian lines; the plaza is those lines buffered by bufferM, kept within clipM of the St. Lorenz church (way 144721691), minus LoD2 buildings
